title: A Shadow of Helpfulman
author: Clara Raubertas
description: You play as Kevin, a graduate student. You share an office with two other graduates: Jim and Molly. Molly Malone is the most beautiful creature in the world. You'd love to ask her out but you're so tongue-tied around her. Jim doesn't have that problem. How can you stop being a shadow of "Helpfulman" Jim?
